children: Overview
Italy yacht maker's 9M 2026 order intake fell 13.8% yr/yr amid geopolitical uncertainty
Net income for 9M 2026 was EUR 49.9 mln
Company saw 6.6% yr/yr rise in Q3 2026 order intake
Outlook
Company says persistent geopolitical uncertainty is leading to longer negotiation times
Ferretti says coverage for FY 2026 remains above 85% with €174 mln net backlog
Result Drivers

GEOPOLITICAL UNCERTAINTY - Co said persistent geopolitical and macroeconomic uncertainty led to longer negotiation times and slowed order intake, especially in made-to-measure and super yacht segments
NEW MODELS - Co attributed increased composite yacht orders to appeal of new models and commercial initiatives
CONTRACT SIGNING - Co said third quarter saw a significant contract signed for a Wally sailing yacht, boosting 'other businesses' segment
